title: Schema-gated partial-emit recovery and toolcall reconciliation tests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Scope: Build an automated test harness and a set of deterministic scenarios that exercise partial JSON emissions over streaming responses where tool/function calls can interleave, and validate schema reconciliation and graceful recovery behaviors. Motivation: production services sometimes receive truncated or interleaved token streams (network issues, preemption, or toolcall fragments). We must ensure the constrained decoder + schema gate can recover or fail safely, emit clear diagnostics, and drive predictable fallback strategies (e.g., re-request, switch-to-relaxed-mode, or return structured error objects).
acceptance_criteria: Test harness can inject token-level truncation at arbitrary offsets and assert the decoder either reconstructs a valid top-level object or returns a deterministic error payload

When a toolcall sentinel appears mid-object, the system applies the reconciliation rules and either merges tool outputs into the expected schema or produces a validated fallback with schema path-level diagnostics
Automated tests run in CI and achieve <1% flakiness over 500 runs for the stable model variants; any nondeterminism must be surfaced as recorded diffs and tickets
Metrics emitted: percent-successful-recovery, avg-time-to-detect-truncation, reconciliation-failure-rate, and example failing token streams stored for triage
Playbook links for runtime behavior (retry logic, canary config) are referenced in test failures and a single remediation PR template is generated
test_plan: Harness: extend streaming-fuzzer to produce: partial token drop, byte-level corruption, mid-object toolcall start/end, and duplicate-sentinel events
Create 12 golden schema scenarios (nested arrays, optional properties, polymorphic union types) and mark expected reconciliation behavior per scenario
Run combinatorial matrix across sequence lengths (32, 256, 1024), concurrency (1, 8, 64), and batching modes (continuous, isolated)
Hook tests into the constrained-decoder telemetry to snapshot internal parse-state and recovered JSON at each checkpoint
Add assertions for structured error payload shape (error.code, error.path, error.suggested_action) to ensure SDKs can programmatically react
observations: Early local experiments show the current gate emits ambiguous diagnostics when a toolcall returns a partial object; need explicit field-level reconciliation rules
KV cache route flapping can reorder tokens in rare preemption tests; we should capture token-offsets in trace metadata
Some legacy models omit sentinel framing under heavy load — tests will simulate sentinel suppression to validate fallback behavior
automation_tasks: Add CI job 'schema-recovery-matrix' that runs nightly with a small sample of model variants and records raw token traces to S3
Implement a minimal 'replay-and-validate' utility that replays saved token streams against the constrained decoder and exports a golden-diff
Integrate failure signal mapping into Alerting: create an alert for recovery-rate drop > 2% over 1h
Create a GitHub Actions workflow to run the harness on PRs touching decoder, stream-gating, or toolcall plumbing
notes: Owner: Marco will pair with Leah Chen to design reconciliation rules for optional vs required fields
Coordinate with QA to add e2e coverage in the SDK layer — SDK must prefer structured error objects over raw text for programmatic handling
If tests expose >5% deterministic recovery failures for a given model, block its rollout to dedicated customers until mitigations are in place
